name: ReTHINK Human
tagline: A new story for how humans belong in community and ecosystem
description: ReTHINK Human is about starting over on the question of, `what is a human?` We dream up and resketch what we are, what should be, and what we could be.
contentSubHeading: Designing humane systems for regenerative living

branchDonations.name: Books and Publications
branchDonations.short: Ideas that reshape how we think and live
branchDonations.description: Donate books on ecology, philosophy, community design, or alternative economics that challenge assumptions and open new possibilities.

branchDonations.name: Workshop Space
branchDonations.description: Offer a space — a living room, community hall, or outdoor area — where people can gather to explore regenerative ideas together.

branchDonations.name: Recording Equipment
branchDonations.short: Tools to capture and share new stories
branchDonations.description: Donate microphones, cameras, or editing equipment so we can record conversations, interviews, and educational content for wider reach.

branchDonations.name: Professional Time
branchDonations.description: Offer your professional time as a designer, facilitator, writer, or systems thinker to help shape curriculum and community programming.

branchDonations.name: Research and Writing Fund
branchDonations.short: Support for deep thinking and publishing
branchDonations.description: Contribute to a fund that pays writers, researchers, and thinkers to develop long-form work on regenerative systems and human flourishing.

branchDonations.name: Event Sponsorship
branchDonations.short: Bring people together around new ideas
branchDonations.description: Sponsor a gathering, symposium, or public talk that helps communities explore what it means to live more humanely and ecologically.

branchFeatures.description: Create practices and places that support human dignity, shared responsibility, and collective learning instead of extraction.
Reimagine time, work, and play so communities can restore rest, participation, and ecological relationship.
Build tools, stories, and learning experiences that make regenerative living easier for families and neighborhoods.

missionTitle: A better human future starts with design
missionText1: We are imagining the systems that support healthy families, meaningful work, and places where nature and culture can grow together.
missionText2: This branch is a call to rethink the rules of housing, education, and community so that people can belong without burning out the planet.
